name: Pyotr Leonidovich Kapitsa

name: George B. Kistiakowsky
calendar_basis: Central State Historical Archives of Ukraine cites the parish metric record for birth on 18 Nov 1900 in the Russian Empire. The archival record is Old Style; in 1900 the Julian-to-Gregorian offset is 13 days, yielding 1 Dec 1900.
notes: Wikidata is used only as a locator/calendar-model cross-check; primary archival citation is the adjudication basis.

name: Boris Petrovich Uvarov
calendar_basis: Archival study based on the Russian State Historical Archive birth registry and university diploma establishes 22 Oct 1886 Old Style = 3 Nov 1886 Gregorian.
notes: This corrects both the year and the day; previous Royal Society-derived value is not retained for the analysis coordinate.

name: Katherine Esau

name: Gregory Breit
